text: Then a local man, Takakuraji, brought Iwarebiko a sword the thunder god had dropped through the roof of his storehouse.
spoken: Then a local man, Tah-kah-koo-rah-jee, brought Ee-wah-reh-bee-ko a sword the thunder god had dropped through the roof of his storehouse.

pauzy.regula: przecinek, po samogłosce, krótkie słowo (1 syl.)
